messages:
Ana: Quick proposal — target release gate for v3.2 on Tue Apr 14 21:00 UTC. Looking to book a 45m go/no-go slot (30m decision + 15m roll-forward/rollback plan). Who can attend? Stakeholders: Jordan (PM), SRE, QA, Security, Release Lead.
Devin: 21:00 UTC works for EU but a bit late for APAC. Can we move to 20:00 UTC to help spot coverage? :thinking_face:
Maria: 20:00 or 21:00 both OK for me. If we shift, can we still keep 45m? Need time for canary signoff.
Ethan: Can do either. Please add a canary smoke checklist to the agenda — will own infra smoke if assigned.
Lisa (SRE): 20:00 is better for my on-call rotation. Need explicit canary owners and the basic smoke steps in the invite. Also request SLO check and post-deploy rollback trigger thresholds on the agenda.
Jordan (PM): Confirmed available at 20:00 UTC. Suggest agenda: quick status, go/no-go vote, canary plan owner assignment, rollback criteria, post-cut validation. Can we include a short pre-read (1 pager) with cut checklist?
Ana: OK — shifting to 20:00 UTC then. Drafting agenda below and attaching in thread. If no objections, I'll create calendar invite and ping stakeholders.
Ana: Agenda (draft):
```
- 00:00-00:05 — Rollcall + objectives (Release Lead)
- 00:05-00:15 — Current readiness snapshot (PM / QA)
- 00:15-00:25 — Canary plan + owner assignment (SRE / Infra)
- 00:25-00:35 — Go/no-go vote and risk discussion (All)
- 00:35-00:45 — Rollback plan & immediate next steps (Release Lead)
```
Ana: Pre-read (one pager) — short checklist: model migrations, infra capacity, data migrations, KMS access verified, backup snapshots, smoke test pass criteria. I'll drop the link once I upload it.
release-bot: Calendar invite created: "v3.2 release gate — Tue Apr 14 20:00 UTC" — attendees: Ana, Jordan (PM), Lisa (SRE), Maria (QA), Devin (Infra), Ethan (Infra). Invite link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123
Devin: Adding hold on my calendar. Can we also add a quick table in the pre-read with 'who owns what' for canary checks?
Maria: I'll fill the QA section in the pre-read: test matrix + mandatory smoke list. ETA: EOD today.
Ethan: I'll add the infra smoke script and expected logs snippet. Quick note for SRE: the smoke will run against canary-1; please confirm that instance will be up-to-date with the cut image.
Lisa (SRE): Confirmed — canary-1 will be staged with the cut image by 18:00 UTC. SRE will run infra smoke and post results in this thread.
Ana: Great. Who will be the rollback owner if the canary fails? I can be release lead, but prefer someone from infra to trigger rollbacks.
Ethan: I can be rollback owner for infra. Will coordinate with SRE.
Jordan (PM): Noted. Also request Security to do a quick config sanity check before cut — @security-team please ack.
Ana: Final RSVP check — confirmed attendees: Ana, Jordan, Lisa, Maria, Devin, Ethan. If anyone else should be on the call (legal/compliance), please flag now.
Devin: tagging eng-oncall as optional standby: @eng-oncall :bell:
Maria: Pre-read link uploaded: https://files.example.com/3.2-preread — contains checklist + QA matrix.
Ana: Thanks — plan: 20:00 UTC Apr 14, 45m slot. I'll send a final reminder 24h before and 1h before with the canary owner assignments and smoke checklist.
Lisa (SRE): SRE smoke run scheduled 19:00 UTC same day; will post results here.
Jordan (PM): Thanks everyone. If nothing else, consider this thread the single source for pre-cut coordination.
Ana: Closing the loop — no objections, moving forward with invite and agenda. See you all on Apr 14 20:00 UTC. :rocket:
